en.title: THQ Nordic Showcase 2026 Reveals Gothic Classics, Let's Sing 2027, and More
en.summary: THQ Nordic just dropped its 2026 showcase, offering a deep dive into its upcoming lineup. From nostalgic Gothic re-releases to a new karaoke challenger, the publisher is catering to a diverse range of player passions.
en.body:
The **THQ Nordic Showcase 2026** has officially aired, giving fans a comprehensive look at the publisher's future slate. While not focused on the massive AAA blockbusters dominating other summer events, THQ Nordic is clearly doubling down on titles that scratch specific gaming itches, from beloved RPG revivals to enduring karaoke fun.

The showcase delivered significant news for fans of the **Gothic** series. **Gothic II Complete Classic** is set to launch on September 29, 2026, followed by **Gothic III Classic** on November 24, 2026. For those who prefer their adventures on the tabletop, a **Gothic: A Shadow's Quest** board game is slated for a Gamefound campaign kick-off on September 30, 2026. This comprehensive approach ensures that the dark fantasy world of Gothic will be accessible across multiple platforms and playstyles.

Beyond the deep RPGs, the **Let's Sing** franchise is gearing up for its next installment with **Let's Sing 2027**. The preshow revealed that the game will feature 35 new songs from artists like **Ariana Grande** and **Chappell Roan**. Additionally, a special **Let's Sing ABBA** pack is arriving on November 3, coinciding with the 50th anniversary of "Dancing Queen," offering 32 tracks from the iconic Swedish group. This pack promises to bring disco fever to living rooms worldwide.

The popular **Pinball FX** also made an appearance, with **Zen Studios** showcasing its extensive collection of tables. The game boasts an impressive array of licensed IPs, ranging from **Peanuts** to **Star Wars**, ensuring a pinball experience for nearly every fan. **Reanal** also received new content, with the DLC **The Prisoner** launching today, expanding the stealthy, spooky adventure for existing players.

## A Nostalgic and Engaging Lineup

For dedicated fans, the **Gothic** announcements are the clear headliners. The revival of these classic RPGs, complete with updated versions, speaks to a strong desire for these intricate world-building experiences. The addition of a board game further cements the franchise's enduring appeal. Meanwhile, the **Let's Sing** series continues its reign in the casual gaming space, with the ABBA pack tapping into a potent vein of nostalgia that transcends generations. It’s a smart move that acknowledges the broad appeal of music and interactive entertainment.

## What's Next

With **Gothic II Complete Classic** arriving September 29, 2026, and **Gothic III Classic** following on November 24, 2026, the latter half of the year looks busy for RPG enthusiasts. The **Let's Sing ABBA** pack is available November 3, 2026. Further details on other projects, including **Wreckfest 2**, were also teased, promising more updates from THQ Nordic as the year progresses.

content_raw: Since the Not-E3 blitz of summer gaming showcases, things have been relatively quiet since then. Amidst that break, THQ Nordic dropped a new showcase full of trailers to show what the publisher has on the way from its various studios. While it wasn't focused on big-name games like the ones you'd find in dedicated Xbox and PlayStation showcases, THQ Nordic instead has titles in very specific niche genres and IP. Several of them are already available via early access or are already out and have post-launch plans in place, so if you're a fan of games that scratch a very specific itch for interactive entertainment, then you'll want to check out the list below of all the announcements. Let's Sing 2027 and Let’s Sing ABBA Revealed in the preshow, Let's Sing 2027 is shaping up to conquer the karaoke video game space. This year's installment features 35 songs from artists such as Ariana Grande and Chappell Roan, and you can join in on singing radio-friendly love songs with or without the original vocals. On top of that, an ABBA pack is also coming to the game on November 3, just in time for the 50th anniversary of Dancing Queen. It includes 32 tracks that your great-grandparents will appreciate, from Waterloo to Mamma Mia. Don't be surprised if they tell you to "gimme gimme gimme" the microphone, Fernando. Pinball FX Another preshow video, Zen Studios showed off its collection of Pinball FX tables that it has assembled over the years. The studio has locked down an impressive number of IP for the game, ranging from Peanuts to Star Wars, and if you're looking for some pinball fun, you can find the game on just about every PC and console. Reanimal: The Prisoner New DLC is on the way for Reanimal in the form of The Prisoner. While it sadly isn't a crossover with the groovy counter-culture '60s TV show that starred Patrick McGoohan, fans of the Little Nightmares-inspired game can look forward to new environmental puzzles and challenges set within a battle-scarred landscape. You can grab it right now. Expeditions: Samurai Developer Campfire Cabal dropped a new trailer for Expeditions: Samurai, its upcoming tactical turn-based-combat game set in feudal Japan. Now out in early access on PC, the developer says that the game will receive three major updates while it works on fine-tuning the experience for players, and it'll be focusing on polishing gameplay balance, exploration, stealth, combat, and more. Titan Quest 2 Now that The Odyssey is the hot new thing in cinemas, it might be the perfect time to check out how the Greek-inspired ARPG Titan Quest 2 is shaping up. Still in early access, today's trailer for the game showed off gameplay for the new Spirit Mastery skills that players can wield in combat. Built around mastering the powers of the Underworld, these powers will allow you to manipulate the forces of life and death to summon spirits and cast spells.
